n1: This is Keelson. An agent harness that runs on your own machine.
n2: Start the server with keelson start.
n3: Now run a workflow. The smoke test exercises every node type. Prompts, commands, loops, bash, and scripts, wired together as a DAG.
n4: Nine nodes, a few seconds, all green.
n5: Every workflow is also in the browser. Find the smoke test, and hit Run.
n6: The graph lights up as each node finishes. You can see which model answered, how long it took, and the output.
n7: And it's all stored locally, so nothing is lost when you close the tab.
n8: Keelson. Lay the keel, raise the ribs.
